title: Auto-Create Zoho Bigin Deals from Incoming Outlook Emails #Shorts
description:
Stop converting emails manually into pipeline deals. Route incoming emails to Zoho Bigin's native Email-In address to generate deals automatically. Follow GSX Automation for more quick Zoho fixes.

1. In Zoho Bigin Settings, navigate to Pipelines and copy the dedicated Email-In address for your target pipeline.
2. In your email client (Outlook or Gmail), create a forwarding rule to route sales inquiry emails to this Email-In address.
3. In Bigin Email-In configuration, map the default deal stage, contact creation rule, and deal owner.

Daily Zoho fixes - follow @GSXAutomation

Question that inspired this: https://www.reddit.com/r/Zoho/comments/1x312vi/zoho_flow_automation_to_create_deals/

story.title: Zoho Flow: Automation to create deals automatically not working as expected.
story.summary: Hey everyone, I'm building an automation workflow on Zoho Flow for a client using Zoho Bigin (Express Plan) and Outlook. I'm running into an issue where the flow completes successfully, but the Deal never actually gets created in Bigin. My client receives 200+ emails/day in Outlook. Right now, Outlook syncs emails into Bigin, but he has to manually approve or reject each email to convert it into a deal. He wants to fully automate this filtering and deal creation step. How I Built the Automation in Zoho Flow: Trigger: New email received in Outlook. Deduplication Check: Check an Audit Log (Zoho Sheet) using the Outlook Conversation ID. If the Conversation ID exists in the log (meaning it's a reply to an existing email thread), the flow stops immediately to prevent duplicate deals. If it’s a new Conversation ID, it proceeds.
